hold_text: manager merges; read-only prop probe, operator pre-authorised 2026-09-27
why: Extends the read-only breakout-login-check to report per-symbol INSTRUMENT SPECS so PI-20260927-ODDTM5QY-0002 (ADAUSD/XRPUSD contract-size confirmation) can resolve without an operator ask. RE-SCOPED 2026-09-27/28 (manager decision) after three rounds of scraping an accessible-name info panel never converged -- each fix produced a new way the WRONG symbol's numbers could be read as the requested one's. The UI-panel approach (search fill, info-panel click, label/value parse, InstrumentSpec on the shared base) is removed entirely; balance/positions/orders are back to exactly main. In its place: DXtradeAdapter.start_response_capture registers a passive page.on('response', ...) hook before login (no click, fill or navigation), and extract_instrument_specs_from_responses walks the captured JSON bodies for objects whose symbol-like key EXACTLY equals a requested symbol (never a substring -- BTCUSDT does not satisfy BTCUSD), printing only allowlisted numeric fields under the key name as served; a field with a differing value across matching objects reports 'conflict' rather than either number. A non-matching response contributes only a redacted discovery line (origin+path, never the query string, and the set of top-level key names, never a value); a sensitive-looking key is never printed even inside a matching object. Instrument results NEVER affect the script's exit code. breakout_login_check.py's --symbols flag is unchanged (default BTCUSD,ETHUSD,SOLUSD,ADAUSD,XRPUSD; --symbols='' skips it). Still READ-ONLY: no code path clicks an order control, emit-status stays off by default. Touches src/prop/platform/dxtrade.py and scripts/prop/breakout_login_check.py (Tier-2 by path: the system action runs them on the live VM).
